d:
Giridih By Election : giridih upchunav ki tarikh ka ailan abhi nahin huaa hai, lekin jharkhand men siyasi bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai. BJP men tikat ke kaee davedar samne aa rahe hain aur har koee jit ka dava kar raha hai. dusri or, JMM ne BJP ke davon par tanj kaste hue kaha hai ki chunav ki ginti hone tak 'kagjon ke sher' jit ke dave karte rahenge.
Giridih men upchunav se pahle BJP aur JMM ke bich jubani jang kyon tej ho gaee hai? janie is riport men chunavi davon aur siyasi palatvar ki puri kahani.
